name: hypothetical-diff
description: Generalizes Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE) from static documents to universal Before/After diffs across any domain—writing, strategy, calendars, contracts, spreadsheets, research, and code. Synthesizes concrete hypothetical deltas to anchor search, align on ambiguous goals, stress-test counterfactual decisions, and reverse-diff root causes in both Google Antigravity and Gemini Spark.
suggestedPrompts: Generate a hypothetical diff for this proposal so we can see what actually changes before committing
Use a hypothetical diff (HyDE style) to search our workspace for where this policy or behavior is defined
Run a counterfactual diff comparing Option A vs Option B across my schedule, budget, and risks
